definition_zh: 具体的；有形的；混凝土；用混凝土铺；使凝固
definition_en: real and able to be seen or touched, or a hard building material made from cement, sand and water
core_image: 工地上刚浇好的灰色地面，脚踩上去还带着凉意
scene: 工地主管让新人先摸一摸刚凝好的地面。You can trust concrete more than a promise.
sceneCN: 这里 concrete 指「混凝土」（第 2 个义项：建筑用的硬质材料）；句意是混凝土比一句承诺更可靠。

senses.title: Real and touchable
senses.definition: existing as a real thing that can be seen or touched
senses.definitionCN: 以看得见摸得着的实物形式存在
senses.example: We need concrete evidence, not guesses.
senses.exampleCN: 我们需要具体证据，而不是猜测。
senses.why: A thing your hand can hold cannot be argued away by words.
senses.whyCN: 手能拿住的东西，不会被几句话否掉。

senses.title: The building material
senses.definition: a hard material made from cement, sand, stones and water
senses.definitionCN: 由水泥、沙子、石子与水混合而成的硬质材料
senses.example: The bridge is made of steel and concrete.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥由钢和混凝土建成。
senses.why: Soft wet stone sets into one body, and that body carries weight.
senses.whyCN: 湿软的料浆结成一个整体，而这个整体能承重。

senses.title: Cover or harden
senses.definition: to cover a surface with concrete, or to become solid
senses.definitionCN: 用混凝土覆盖表面，或使某物变硬凝固
senses.example: They concreted the yard last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他们去年夏天把院子铺上了混凝土。
senses.why: The verb keeps the old image of parts growing into one solid mass.
senses.whyCN: 动词用法保留了旧意象：各部分长成一个硬块。

intro.en: Concrete comes from Latin concretus, meaning grown together, and first described matter that had hardened into one mass.
intro.cn: concrete 来自拉丁语 concretus，意为一起长成，最初描述硬化成一整块的物质。

items.en: Com- meant together and crescere meant to grow.
items.cn: com- 表示一起，crescere 表示生长。

items.en: Concretus described something that had grown into a solid body.
items.cn: concretus 描述长成一个坚实整体的东西。

items.en: Old French concret named things formed by union.
items.cn: 古法语 concret 指由结合而形成的东西。

items.en: English first used concrete for matter hardened into one body.
items.cn: 英语最初用 concrete 指硬结成一块的物质。

items.en: It now names a building material and also means real and particular.
items.cn: 如今它指建筑材料，也表示真实而具体的。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the ending of concrete, and the meaning group names other ways to say real and exact.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concrete 词尾相近的词，近义组列出其他表示真实确切的说法。

entries.definition: an idea formed in the mind
a public performance of music
separate and clearly different
clear and exact rather than general
real enough to be touched or felt
hard and firm in form

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from wet cement, then move to hard ground and to facts you can point at.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从湿水泥开始，再走到硬地面与可以用手指点出的事实。

normal.en: Con- is together and cret- is grown, so concrete is what has grown into one block.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cret- 是生长，所以 concrete 就是长成一整块的东西。

normal.en: Wet cement is an idea, and the dry floor is a concrete plan.
normal.cn: 湿水泥只是一个想法，干透的地面才是具体的计划。

normal.en: A concrete example is one you can put on the table.
normal.cn: 具体的例子，就是能摆到桌上的那个例子。

normal.en: Concrete evidence stands like a wall that no excuse can push over.
normal.cn: 具体证据像一堵墙，任何借口都推不倒。

normal.en: If a promise has no numbers and no dates, it is not concrete yet.
normal.cn: 一个承诺若没有数字和日期，就还不够具体。

abstract.en: Picture a grey floor still shining with water.
abstract.cn: 想象一片还泛着水光的灰色地面。

abstract.en: Picture a stone that holds the shape of the mould.
abstract.cn: 想象一块保留了模具形状的石头。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pressing a fact flat on the desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把一件事实按在桌上。

examples.en: The plan is good, but we need concrete steps.
examples.cn: 计划不错，但我们需要具体步骤。

examples.en: The wall was built with reinforced concrete.
examples.cn: 这堵墙是用钢筋混凝土建的。

examples.en: Her advice was concrete and easy to follow.
examples.cn: 她的建议很具体，也容易照做。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concrete 记成 con（一起）加 cret（生长）：沙石水泥一起长成硬块，就是混凝土；看得见摸得着，就是具体。

root: 源自拉丁语 concretus（com 一起 + crescere 生长），本义是一起长成硬块，后引申为具体的、有形的与混凝土。

sensesIntro.en: From wet cement setting into a floor, to a fact you can point at, and finally to the act of hardening.
sensesIntro.cn: 从湿水泥凝成地面，到可以用手指点出的事实，最后到凝固这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: wet cement, sand and stones setting into one hard floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：湿水泥、沙子和石子凝成一片坚硬的地面。

branches.en: Something concrete can be shown, measured and pointed at.
branches.cn: 具体的东西可以展示、测量、用手指点出来。

branches.en: The building material is the most literal picture of the word.
branches.cn: 建筑材料是这个词最字面的画面。

branches.en: The verb turns the material into an action of covering or hardening.
branches.cn: 动词用法把这个材料变成铺设或凝固的动作。

branches.en: A floor you can stand on proves that the idea has become real.
branches.cn: 能站上去的地面，证明想法已经变成现实。

branches.en: Pouring and setting are the two halves of one process.
branches.cn: 浇筑与凝固是同一过程的两个半边。

intro.en: Concrete is built on Latin com-, together, plus crescere, to grow.
intro.cn: concrete 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 crescere（生长）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin grow base cresc- also appears in increase and crescent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的生长词基 cresc- 也出现在 increase 与 crescent 中。

items.meaning: to harden into one solid mass
items.example: The mud concreted in the hot sun.
items.exampleCN: 泥浆在烈日下凝成了硬块。

items.meaning: in a real and specific way
items.exampleCN: 请具体说明你的目标。

items.meaning: the quality of being real and exact
items.example: The concreteness of the plan convinced them.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划的具体性说服了他们。

items.meaning: a hard mass formed by growth
items.example: The rock contained a small concretion.
items.exampleCN: 这块岩石里有一个小结核。

items.example: They concretized the vision in one page.
items.exampleCN: 他们把这个愿景具体化成一页纸。

items.example: Concreting begins early in the morning.
items.exampleCN: 浇筑混凝土一大早就开始。

items.meaning: a machine that turns cement with sand and water
items.example: A concrete mixer roared beside the road.
items.exampleCN: 一台混凝土搅拌机在路边轰鸣。
这块楼板使用了钢筋混凝土。

definition_zh: 谴责；判刑；定罪；宣布不宜使用
definition_en: to say strongly that something is wrong, or to sentence someone to punishment
core_image: 法官敲下木槌，当庭宣读判决
scene: 邻居们一致指责那家工厂污染了河水。The whole town condemned the factory for polluting the river.
sceneCN: 这里 condemn 指「谴责」（第 1 个义项：公开表示强烈反对）；句意是全镇人都谴责那家工厂污染河水。

pos.zh: 谴责；判刑；宣布不宜使用

senses.title: Name as wrong
senses.definition: to say in public that something is very wrong
senses.definitionCN: 公开表示某事非常错误
senses.example: The report condemned the use of child labour.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告谴责使用童工的行为。
senses.why: A public voice turns private dislike into a shared judgement.
senses.whyCN: 公开的声音把私人的反感变成共同的评判。

senses.title: Give a punishment
senses.definition: to order a legal punishment for someone
senses.definitionCN: 依法对某人作出惩罚判决
senses.example: The court condemned him to life in prison.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭判处他终身监禁。
senses.why: The court speaks with the weight of the whole community behind it.
senses.whyCN: 法庭说话时，背后是整个共同体的分量。

senses.title: Declare unsafe
senses.definition: to officially state that a building or object cannot be used
senses.definitionCN: 正式宣布某建筑或物品不能继续使用
senses.example: Inspectors condemned the old school building.
senses.exampleCN: 检查人员宣布这栋旧校舍不宜使用。
senses.why: A thing judged unfit is given a sentence just as a person is.
senses.whyCN: 被判定不合格的东西，也像人一样被判了刑。

intro.en: Condemn comes from Latin condemnare, to sentence or blame, built from com-, fully, and damnare, to harm or find guilty.
intro.cn: condemn 来自拉丁语 condemnare，意为判罪或指责，由 com-（彻底）与 damnare（损害、定罪）构成。

items.en: Damnare meant to find someone guilty and set a penalty.
items.cn: damnare 意为判定某人有罪并定下惩罚。

items.en: Condemnare added com- to make the judgement complete.
items.cn: condemnare 加上 com-，表示判决彻底成立。

items.en: Old French condemner carried the legal sense into common use.
items.cn: 古法语 condemner 把这个法律含义带入日常用法。

items.en: English condemn first meant to sentence a person in court.
items.cn: 英语 condemn 最初指在法庭上给人判刑。

items.en: It now also means to state strong moral disapproval in public.
items.cn: 如今它也指在公开场合表达强烈的道德反对。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that begin like condemn, and the meaning group names other ways of blaming or punishing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 condemn 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他指责或惩罚的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a court ruling, then move to a public protest and to a building marked unsafe.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从法庭判决开始，再走到公开抗议与被标记为危险的建筑。

normal.en: Con- means fully and damn- means to find guilty, so to condemn is to find fully guilty.
normal.cn: con- 表示彻底，damn- 表示定罪，所以 condemn 就是把罪名彻底定下。

normal.en: A judge condemns with a hammer, and a crowd condemns with a shout.
normal.cn: 法官用木槌定罪，人群用喊声谴责。

normal.en: Condemn and damn share the same core, which is why the word feels so heavy.
normal.cn: condemn 与 damn 共享同一个核心，所以这个词听起来很重。

normal.en: A condemned building is a building that has been sentenced.
normal.cn: 一栋被判定的建筑，就是一栋被宣判的建筑。

normal.en: Strong words condemn, and strong walls condemn too.
normal.cn: 强烈的话语在谴责，坚固的墙也可能被判为不能用。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden hammer falling on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一把木槌落在桌面上。

abstract.en: Picture a row of raised hands in a meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象会议上举起的一排手。

abstract.en: Picture a red sign nailed to a broken door.
abstract.cn: 想象一块红色告示钉在破损的门上。

examples.en: World leaders condemned the attack on the hospital.
examples.cn: 各国领导人谴责了针对医院的袭击。

examples.en: He was condemned to five years in prison.
examples.cn: 他被判处五年监禁。

examples.en: Engineers condemned the bridge after the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水过后，工程师宣布这座桥不能再用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condemn 记成 con（彻底）加 demn（定罪）：把罪名彻底定下来，就是谴责与判刑。

root: 源自拉丁语 condemnare（com 彻底 + damnare 定罪），本义是判定有罪，后引申为公开谴责与宣布废弃。

sensesIntro.en: From a court sentence, to a public moral judgement, and finally to a building declared unfit.
sensesIntro.cn: 从法庭判决，到公开的道德评判，最后到被宣布不能使用的建筑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hammer falls and a whole crowd agrees with the verdict.
core.cn: 核心意象：木槌落下，全场人都认同这个判决。

branches.en: Condemnation by words needs an audience to become powerful.
branches.cn: 用言语谴责，需要听众才能产生力量。

branches.en: The legal sense gives the word its official weight.
branches.cn: 法律义项赋予这个词官方的分量。

branches.en: Buildings and objects can receive the same verdict.
branches.cn: 建筑和物品也会收到同样的判决。

branches.en: Both blame and punish by naming the act as wrong.
branches.cn: 谴责与判刑都先把行为认定为错误。

branches.en: A person and a place can both be sentenced out of use.
branches.cn: 人与地方都可能被判为不能再使用。

intro.en: Condemn is built on Latin com-, fully, plus damnare, to find guilty.
intro.cn: condemn 由拉丁语 com-（彻底）与 damnare（定罪）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base damn- also appears in damn and damage.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 damn- 也出现在 damn 与 damage 中。

items.meaning: to state that something is wrong
items.example: They condemn all forms of cheating.
items.exampleCN: 他们谴责一切形式的作弊。

items.example: The letter condemns the new policy.
items.exampleCN: 这封信谴责新政策。
法官对欺诈行为定了罪。
她写了一份谴责性的报告。
这个计划遭到广泛谴责。
他发表了一篇谴责性的讲话。
这一行为显然该受谴责。

items.example: He damned the delay as careless.
items.exampleCN: 他斥责这次延误太粗心。

definition_en: to make something shorter or denser, or to change from gas to liquid
core_image: 炉上的一锅汤慢慢收干，只剩浓浓的精华
scene: 厨师把汤再熬一会儿，让味道更集中。Simmer the sauce to condense its flavour.
sceneCN: 这里 condense 指「使浓缩」（第 2 个义项：让液体变得更浓）；句意是把酱汁再熬一会儿，让味道更浓。

senses.title: Make writing shorter
senses.definition: to reduce a speech or piece of writing to fewer words
senses.definitionCN: 把讲话或文章减少到更少的字数
senses.example: She condensed the report into two pages.
senses.exampleCN: 她把报告压缩成了两页。
senses.why: A shorter text keeps only what cannot be removed.
senses.whyCN: 更短的文字只留下删不掉的部分。

senses.title: Make a liquid denser
senses.definition: to make a liquid thicker by removing water
senses.definitionCN: 通过去掉水分使液体变浓
senses.example: Boil the soup to condense the flavour.
senses.exampleCN: 把汤煮一煮，让味道更浓。
senses.why: Less water means more taste in every spoon.
senses.whyCN: 水少了，每一勺里的味道就更多。

senses.title: Turn gas into drops
senses.definition: to change from a gas into a liquid
senses.definitionCN: 由气体变成液体
senses.example: Steam condensed on the cold window.
senses.exampleCN: 蒸汽在冰冷的窗上凝结。
senses.why: Cool air pulls the wandering vapour back into drops.
senses.whyCN: 冷空气把游走的水汽拉回成水珠。

intro.en: Condense comes from Latin condensare, to make dense, built from com-, together, and densus, thick.
intro.cn: condense 来自拉丁语 condensare，意为使浓密，由 com-（一起）与 densus（浓密）构成。

items.en: Densus described air or matter packed closely together.
items.cn: densus 描述空气或物质紧密挤在一起。

items.en: Condensare meant to press something into a smaller space.
items.cn: condensare 意为把东西压进更小的空间。

items.en: French condenser applied the idea to both text and vapour.
items.cn: 法语 condenser 把这个意思同时用于文字与水汽。

items.en: English condense first described liquids thickened by heat.
items.cn: 英语 condense 最初描述用加热变浓的液体。

items.en: It now also means to shorten a text without losing its main point.
items.cn: 如今它也指在不丢失要点的前提下缩短文字。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that begin like condense, and the meaning group names other ways of making something smaller or thicker.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 condense 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他让东西变小或变浓的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a pot on a stove, then move to a shortened page and to drops on cold glass.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从炉上的锅开始，再走到被缩短的页面与冷玻璃上的水珠。

normal.en: Con- is together and dense means thick, so condense is to press things together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，dense 是浓密，所以 condense 就是把东西挤到一起。

normal.en: A long report condensed is a short report that still works.
normal.cn: 被压缩的长报告，是一份仍然管用的短报告。

normal.en: Condensed milk is milk that has lost most of its water.
normal.cn: 炼乳就是去掉了大部分水分的牛奶。

normal.en: Steam condenses the moment it meets something cold.
normal.cn: 蒸汽一碰到冷的东西就凝结。

normal.en: Condense the message until only the point is left.
normal.cn: 把信息压缩到只剩要点为止。

abstract.en: Picture a wide cloud squeezed into a single drop.
abstract.cn: 想象一片大云被挤成一颗水珠。

abstract.en: Picture a thick book folded into a thin card.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚书被折成一张薄卡片。

abstract.en: Picture soup bubbling down to a dark rich paste.
abstract.cn: 想象汤汁收成一小团深色浓浆。

examples.en: The editor condensed the article to one page.
examples.cn: 编辑把文章压缩到了一页。

examples.en: Water vapour condenses into drops on the glass.
examples.cn: 水蒸气在玻璃上凝结成水珠。

examples.en: Add less water if you want to condense the sauce.
examples.cn: 若想让酱汁更浓，就少加点水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condense 记成 con（一起）加 dense（浓密）：把东西挤到一起、把水去掉，就是压缩与浓缩；水汽挤成水珠就是凝结。

root: 源自拉丁语 condensare（com 一起 + densus 浓密），本义是挤密，后引申为压缩文字、浓缩液体与凝结。

sensesIntro.en: From a thickened liquid, to a shortened text, and finally to vapour turning into water.
sensesIntro.cn: 从变浓的液体，到被缩短的文字，最后到水汽变成水。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide cloud pressed into one heavy drop.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片宽大的云被压成一颗沉甸甸的水珠。

branches.en: Text is condensed by removing what can be spared.
branches.cn: 文字靠删去可有可无的部分来压缩。

branches.en: A liquid is condensed by driving off its water.
branches.cn: 液体靠赶走水分来浓缩。

branches.en: Cooling makes vapour gather back into drops.
branches.cn: 降温让水汽重新聚成水珠。

branches.en: Both senses leave more value in a smaller space.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让更小的空间里装下更多内容。

branches.en: Thickening and dripping are two ends of the same process.
branches.cn: 变浓与滴落是同一过程的两端。

intro.en: Condense is built on Latin com-, together, plus densus, thick or dense.
intro.cn: condense 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 densus（浓密）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dens- also appears in dense and density.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dens- 也出现在 dense 与 density 中。

items.example: Condense the paragraph if you can.
items.exampleCN: 如果可以就把这段压缩一下。

items.example: Cold air condenses the vapour quickly.
items.exampleCN: 冷空气让水汽很快凝结。

definition_zh: 条件；状况；环境；使适应；护理
definition_en: something that must exist before something else can happen, or the state something is in
core_image: 一个人反复擦拭旧手表，让它保持准确的走时
scene: 二手车商把每辆车的状况写在小牌上。The condition of the tyres decides the price.
sceneCN: 这里 condition 指「状况」（第 2 个义项：人或物所处的状态）；句意是轮胎的状况决定价格。

senses.title: Something required first
senses.definition: a thing that must happen or exist before something else is possible
senses.definitionCN: 必须先发生或存在，其他事才可能实现的事
senses.example: Patience is a condition of good teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 耐心是做好教学的一个条件。
senses.why: A door needs a key before it can open, and a result needs its condition.
senses.whyCN: 门要先有钥匙才能开，结果也要先有条件。

senses.title: The state of something
senses.definition: the physical state that a person or thing is in
senses.definitionCN: 人或物在身体或物理上的状态
senses.example: The car is still in good condition.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆车状况仍然良好。
senses.why: You judge a thing by how well it still does its job.
senses.whyCN: 判断一件东西，就看它还能把本分做得多好。

senses.title: Train or care for
senses.definition: to train someone to react in a certain way, or to keep something healthy
senses.definitionCN: 训练某人形成某种反应，或使某物保持良好状态
senses.example: The animals were conditioned to accept people.
senses.exampleCN: 这些动物被训练得能接受人类。
senses.why: Repeated practice shapes a response, and repeated care keeps a thing fit.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习塑造反应，反复护理让东西保持良好。

intro.en: Condition comes from Latin condicio, an agreement or situation, from condicere, to talk something over together.
intro.cn: condition 来自拉丁语 condicio，意为约定或情形，源自动词 condicere（一起商谈）。

items.en: Condicere joined com-, together, with dicere, to say.
items.cn: condicere 由 com-（一起）与 dicere（说）组合而成。

items.en: Condicio named the terms that two sides agreed on.
items.cn: condicio 指双方商定的条款。

items.en: Old French condition kept both the agreement and the state senses.
items.cn: 古法语 condition 同时保留了约定与状况两种含义。

items.en: English condition first meant a stated requirement.
items.cn: 英语 condition 最初指明确提出的要求。

items.en: It now also covers health, surroundings and the training of behaviour.
items.cn: 如今它也覆盖健康、环境与行为训练。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words with a similar ending, and the meaning group names other words for a state or a requirement.
note.cn: 形近组收的是词尾相近的词，近义组列出其他表示状态或要求的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a contract, then move to the state of a car and to trained behaviour.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一份契约开始，再走到汽车的状况与训练出的行为。

normal.en: Con- is together and dic- is say, so a condition is something two sides say together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，dic- 是说，所以 condition 是双方一起说定的事。

normal.en: A contract lists conditions, and a used car has a condition too.
normal.cn: 合同列出条件，二手车也有自己的状况。

normal.en: On condition that means only if the other side keeps its word.
normal.cn: on condition that 的意思就是只有对方守约才行。

normal.en: Conditioner keeps hair in good condition.
normal.cn: 护发素让头发保持良好状态。

normal.en: An athlete conditions the body by repeating the same move.
normal.cn: 运动员靠重复同一个动作来训练身体。

abstract.en: Picture two hands signing the same sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在同一张纸上签字。

abstract.en: Picture a gauge that shows how much life is left.
abstract.cn: 想象一个显示还剩多少寿命的仪表。

abstract.en: Picture water slowly shaping a stone day by day.
abstract.cn: 想象水一天天慢慢塑造一块石头。

examples.en: Hard work is one condition of success.
examples.cn: 努力是成功的一个条件。

examples.en: The house is in excellent condition.
examples.cn: 这栋房子的状况极好。

examples.en: Years of training conditioned her to stay calm.
examples.cn: 多年训练让她习惯于保持冷静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condition 记成 con（一起）加 dit（说）加 ion：双方一起说定的条款是条件，说定的当下情形就是状况。

root: 源自拉丁语 condicio（com 一起 + dicere 说），本义是双方说定的条款，后引申为条件、状况与环境。

sensesIntro.en: From agreed terms, to the state of a thing, and finally to the shaping of behaviour.
sensesIntro.cn: 从商定的条款，到事物的状态，最后到行为的塑造。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people agree on terms, and a gauge shows how well things stand.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人谈定条款，同时一个仪表显示现状如何。

branches.en: A condition is what must be true before the result can follow.
branches.cn: 条件是结果出现之前必须成立的事。

branches.en: The state sense asks how well something still works.
branches.cn: 状况义项关心的是某物还能运转得多好。

branches.en: Training and care both aim at keeping a good state.
branches.cn: 训练与护理都以保持良好状态为目标。

branches.en: Terms and states are both fixed points you can check.
branches.cn: 条款与状态都是可以核对的固定点。

branches.en: Good care today is the condition of good condition tomorrow.
branches.cn: 今天的良好护理，是明天状况良好的条件。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的说话词基 dic- 也出现在 predict 与 dictionary 中。

definition_zh: 行为；举止；实施；进行；指挥；传导
definition_en: the way a person behaves, or to organize an activity and carry it out
core_image: 乐队指挥举起双手，让整个乐团同时发声
scene: 老师带学生参观实验室，提醒大家注意行为举止。His conduct in the lab impressed every teacher.
sceneCN: 这里 conduct 指「行为举止」（第 1 个义项：一个人在公开场合的表现）；句意是他在实验室里的举止让每位老师都印象深刻。

senses.title: The way one behaves
senses.definition: the way a person acts, especially in public or at work
senses.definitionCN: 一个人行事的方式，尤指在公开场合或工作中的表现
senses.example: His conduct during the meeting was calm.
senses.exampleCN: 他在会议上的举止很沉稳。
senses.why: Others cannot see your motives, so they judge what you do.
senses.whyCN: 别人看不见你的动机，只能凭你的所做来判断。

senses.title: Carry out an activity
senses.definition: to organize and carry out a plan, test or study
senses.definitionCN: 组织并完成计划、测试或研究
senses.example: The team conducted a survey of local farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 团队对当地农民做了一次调查。
senses.why: An activity needs someone to lead it from start to finish.
senses.whyCN: 一项活动需要有人从头到尾带着走。

senses.title: Lead a group or carry energy
senses.definition: to direct a group such as an orchestra, or to carry heat or electricity
senses.definitionCN: 指挥乐团等团体，或输送热与电
senses.example: Copper conducts electricity very well.
senses.exampleCN: 铜的导电性非常好。
senses.why: A leader and a wire both carry something from one end to the other.
senses.whyCN: 领导者与电线都在把某样东西从一端送到另一端。

intro.en: Conduct comes from Latin conducere, to lead together, built from com-, together, and ducere, to lead.
intro.cn: conduct 来自拉丁语 conducere，意为一起带领，由 com-（一起）与 ducere（引导）构成。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead a person or an army along a road.
items.cn: ducere 意为带着人或军队沿路前行。

items.en: Conducere meant to bring several things together under one lead.
items.cn: conducere 意为把几件事物收拢到同一个带领之下。

items.en: Old French conduire used the word for guiding and managing.
items.cn: 古法语 conduire 用这个词表示引导与管理。

items.en: English conduct first named the act of leading or guiding.
items.cn: 英语 conduct 最初指带领与引导的行为。

items.en: It now covers behaviour as well as the carrying of heat and electricity.
items.cn: 如今它既指行为举止，也指热与电的输送。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same Latin lead base, and the meaning group names other ways of behaving or leading.
note.cn: 形近组收的是建立在同一拉丁词基上的词，近义组列出其他表示行为或带领的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a conductor raising a baton, then move to a research team and to a copper wire.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从举起指挥棒的人开始，再走到研究团队与一根铜线。

normal.en: Con- is together and duct- is lead, so conduct is to lead things together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，duct- 是引导，所以 conduct 就是把事情一起带着走。

normal.en: A teacher conducts a class, and a wire conducts a current.
normal.cn: 老师带领一个班级，电线传导一股电流。

normal.en: Your conduct is simply how you lead yourself in public.
normal.cn: 你的行为举止，就是你在人前带领自己的方式。

normal.en: To conduct a survey, first write down what you want to ask.
normal.cn: 要开展调查，先写下你想问的内容。

normal.en: Bad conduct at work can end a career faster than bad luck.
normal.cn: 工作中的不当行为，比运气不好更快毁掉前程。

abstract.en: Picture a baton drawing one line through the air.
abstract.cn: 想象一根指挥棒在空中划出一条线。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow pipe carrying water downhill.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细管把水引向低处。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd following one person through a gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人跟着一个人穿过大门。

examples.en: The school expects good conduct from every student.
examples.cn: 学校要求每位学生行为端正。

examples.en: They conducted the experiment twice to be sure.

root: 源自拉丁语 conducere（com 一起 + ducere 引导），本义是一起带领，后引申为实施、指挥、传导与行为举止。

sensesIntro.en: From leading a group, to carrying out a study, and finally to the way one carries oneself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从带领一群人，到开展一项研究，最后到一个人立身行事的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one raised hand leads an orchestra, a team, or a current of electricity.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只举起的手，带着乐团、团队或一股电流。

branches.en: Conduct as behaviour is the self under the eyes of others.
branches.cn: 行为义项是自我在别人目光下的样子。

branches.en: To conduct a study is to lead it from question to answer.
branches.cn: 开展研究就是从问题一直领到答案。

branches.en: Leading a group and carrying a current share the same movement.
branches.cn: 带领团队与传导电流共享同一种运动。

branches.en: Good conduct helps any activity run smoothly.
branches.cn: 良好的举止能让任何活动顺利开展。

branches.en: Both senses need a clear path from one end to the other.
branches.cn: 两个义项都需要一条从一端到另一端的畅通路径。

intro.en: Conduct is built on Latin com-, together, plus ducere, to lead.

senses.title: Leader of an orchestra
senses.definition: a person who stands in front of musicians and directs their playing
senses.definitionCN: 站在乐手前方、指挥他们演奏的人
senses.example: The conductor raised her baton and the hall fell silent.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥举起指挥棒，音乐厅立刻安静下来。
senses.why: Many players need one pair of hands to set the same beat.
senses.whyCN: 许多乐手需要一双手来定下同一个节拍。

senses.title: A material that carries energy
senses.definition: a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it
senses.definitionCN: 允许热或电通过的物质
senses.example: Copper is a common conductor of electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 铜是常见的电导体。
senses.why: Some materials let energy walk through them instead of blocking it.
senses.whyCN: 有些材料让能量从内部通过，而不是把它挡住。

senses.title: Ticket officer on a vehicle
senses.definition: a person on a bus or train who checks or sells tickets
senses.definitionCN: 在公交或列车上查票、卖票的工作人员
senses.example: The conductor asked to see our tickets.
senses.exampleCN: 列车员要求查看我们的车票。
senses.why: The same word for leading now names the one who keeps a journey in order.
senses.whyCN: 同一个表示带领的词，如今指维持旅程秩序的人。

items.en: Conducere meant to bring people or things under one lead.
items.cn: conducere 意为把人与物收拢到同一个带领之下。

items.en: Conductor named a person who hired or guided others.

items.en: English conductor first meant a guide or a leader.

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same Latin lead base, and the meaning group names other people who guide or carry.

senses.definition: to officially give someone an honour, degree or right
senses.definitionCN: 正式把荣誉、学位或权利给予某人
senses.example: The university conferred a degree on him.
senses.exampleCN: 大学授予他一个学位。
senses.why: A gift of status must be given in public to count.
senses.whyCN: 身份的赠予必须在公开场合给出才算数。

senses.title: Talk something over
senses.definition: to discuss a matter with other people before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 在做决定前与他人讨论某事
senses.example: The judges conferred quietly before they voted.
senses.exampleCN: 评委在投票前低声商议。
senses.why: Two heads brought together can see more than one.
senses.whyCN: 两个脑袋凑在一起，能看到一个人看不到的东西。

intro.en: Confer comes from Latin conferre, to bring together, built from com-, together, and ferre, to carry.
intro.cn: confer 来自拉丁语 conferre，意为带到一起，由 com-（一起）与 ferre（携带）构成。

items.en: Ferre meant to carry or bring something to a place.
items.cn: ferre 意为把某物携带或带到某处。

items.en: Conferre meant to bring things or people into one place.
items.cn: conferre 意为把东西或人带到同一个地方。

items.en: It also came to mean to compare, since comparing brings two things side by side.
items.cn: 它也引申为比较，因为比较就是把两样东西并排放到一起。

items.en: English confer first meant to compare and then to consult.
items.cn: 英语 confer 最初表示比较，随后表示商议。

items.en: It now also means to give an honour or a right in a formal way.
items.cn: 如今它也指以正式方式授予荣誉或权利。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that rhyme with confer, and the meaning group names other ways of giving or discussing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 confer 押韵的词，近义组列出其他表示给予或商议的说法。

entries.definition: to mention or send someone for help
to put something off to a later time
to reach a conclusion from evidence
to give something formally or legally
to give an honour as a gift
to ask someone for advice or information

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a medal on a stage, then move to a small circle of judges and to a gift of rights.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从台上的奖章开始，再走到围坐的评委与一份权利的赠予。

normal.en: Con- is together and fer- is carry, so confer is to carry something to someone.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，fer- 是携带，所以 confer 就是把东西送到别人那里。

normal.en: A degree conferred is a paper carried across a stage.
normal.cn: 被授予的学位，就是一张被带上台的纸。

normal.en: Judges confer because a decision carried by several minds weighs more.
normal.cn: 评委要商议，因为几个人共同作出的决定更有分量。

normal.en: Confer with a friend before you confer a promise.
normal.cn: 在给出承诺之前，先和朋友商议一下。

normal.en: The same word gives an honour and asks for advice.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既给出荣誉，也征求建议。

abstract.en: Picture a medal laid in an open hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚奖章被放进摊开的手掌。

abstract.en: Picture three chairs pulled into a tight circle.
abstract.cn: 想象三把椅子被拉成一个紧圈。

abstract.en: Picture two maps laid side by side on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象两张地图并排摊在桌上。

examples.en: The college conferred an honorary degree on her.
examples.cn: 学院授予她荣誉学位。

examples.en: The doctors conferred before they began the operation.
examples.cn: 医生们在手术开始前进行了商议。

examples.en: You should confer with your family first.
examples.cn: 你应该先和家人商量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confer 记成 con（一起）加 fer（带）：把荣誉带给人是授予，把问题带到一起讨论就是商议。

root: 源自拉丁语 conferre（com 一起 + ferre 携带），本义是带到一起，后引申为比较、商议与授予。

sensesIntro.en: From carrying things into one place, to talking a matter over, and finally to handing an honour to someone.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把东西带到一处，到把事情放在一起讨论，最后到把荣誉交到某人手上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people bring their views to one table, and one brings a gift to the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人把看法带到同一张桌上，同时一个人把礼物递给另一个人。

branches.en: An honour is carried from the giver to the receiver.
branches.cn: 荣誉从授予者手中被送到接受者那里。

branches.en: A discussion brings several minds into one place.
branches.cn: 商议把几个人的想法带到同一个地方。

branches.en: Both senses depend on bringing people or things together.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖把人或事物带到一起。

branches.en: The act of conferring is the short meeting before a decision.
branches.cn: 商议就是做决定前的那场短会。

branches.en: The giving sense carries the same image into ceremony.
branches.cn: 授予义项把同一个意象带进了典礼。

intro.en: Confer is built on Latin com-, together, plus ferre, to carry.
intro.cn: confer 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 ferre（携带）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin carry base fer- also appears in transfer, refer and offer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的携带词基 fer- 也出现在 transfer、refer 与 offer 中。

items.exampleCN: 他们商议了一个小时。
这个头衔带来很大的尊重。
国王授予了爵士身份。

items.example: They are conferring in the next room.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在隔壁房间商议。
会议在周一开幕。

items.meaning: the act of giving an honour
items.exampleCN: 这次授予在安静中完成。

items.meaning: the giving of a degree or right
items.example: The conferral of the prize was delayed.
items.exampleCN: 奖项的授予被推迟了。

items.example: They transferred the file to a new drive.
items.exampleCN: 他们把文件转到了新硬盘上。

definition_en: a large meeting where people discuss a subject or share ideas
core_image: 长桌两旁坐满人，每人面前一支麦克风
scene: 各地医生聚在大厅里交流新研究。She met her future partner at a medical conference.
sceneCN: 这里 conference 指「会议」（第 1 个义项：多人聚集讨论专业问题的场合）；句意是她在一次医学会议上遇见了未来的伴侣。

senses.title: A large formal meeting
senses.definition: a large meeting where people discuss a shared subject
senses.definitionCN: 许多人聚集讨论共同主题的大型会议
senses.example: The annual conference drew two thousand guests.
senses.exampleCN: 年度会议吸引了两千名来宾。
senses.why: A shared subject gives strangers a reason to sit in one room.
senses.whyCN: 共同的主题让陌生人有了坐进同一个房间的理由。

senses.title: A private discussion
senses.definition: a private discussion between a few people before a decision
senses.definitionCN: 少数人在做决定前的私下商谈
senses.example: After a short conference, the two sides agreed.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂商谈之后，双方达成了一致。
senses.why: Some words are said best when only a few people are listening.
senses.whyCN: 有些话在只有少数人听的时候最好说。

intro.en: Conference comes from Latin conferentia, a bringing together, from conferre, to bring together.
intro.cn: conference 来自拉丁语 conferentia，意为聚集，源自 conferre（带到一起）。

items.en: Conferre meant to carry people or ideas into one place.
items.cn: conferre 意为把人或想法带到同一个地方。

items.en: Conferentia named the state of being gathered together.
items.cn: conferentia 指被聚集到一起的状态。

items.en: French conference named a formal meeting for talks.
items.cn: 法语 conference 指为商谈而举行的正式会面。

items.en: English conference first meant a conversation between parties.
items.cn: 英语 conference 最初指各方之间的交谈。

items.en: It now mainly names a large meeting of people with a shared interest.
items.cn: 如今它主要指有共同兴趣的人举行的大型会议。

note.en: The look-alike group holds nouns built from the same Latin root, and the meaning group names other kinds of gathering.
note.cn: 形近组收的是由同一拉丁词根构成的名词，近义组列出其他类型的聚会。

entries.definition: the act of giving an honour
the giving of a degree or right
the place where two rivers meet
an event where people come together to talk
a large meeting of people with one interest
a small class for discussion and study

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a long table full of microphones, then move to a small closed room and to name badges.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从摆满麦克风的长桌开始，再走到一间关起门的小屋与一排名牌。

normal.en: Confer plus -ence is the noun of bringing people together.
normal.cn: confer 加 -ence，就是把人们聚到一起这件事的名词。

normal.en: A conference is a room where every chair faces the same screen.
normal.cn: 会议就是每把椅子都朝向同一块屏幕的房间。

normal.en: A press conference is a short meeting built for questions.
normal.cn: 记者招待会就是为提问而设的短会。

normal.en: The conference badge tells others which subject you came for.
normal.cn: 会议名牌会告诉别人你是为哪个主题而来。

normal.en: In conference, people confer, and then they return to work.
normal.cn: 在会议里人们商议，然后回到工作中。

abstract.en: Picture a forest of name cards on a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一长桌上立起一片名牌。

abstract.en: Picture a hundred voices dropping to a whisper.
abstract.cn: 想象上百个声音一起降到耳语。

abstract.en: Picture one slide lighting a dark hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一张幻灯片照亮昏暗的大厅。

examples.en: She gave a talk at the conference on climate.
examples.cn: 她在气候会议上做了报告。

examples.en: The two leaders held a private conference.
examples.cn: 两位领导人举行了私下商谈。

examples.en: Our conference room is booked all morning.
examples.cn: 我们的会议室整个上午都被订满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conference 记成 confer（带到一起）加 ence：把许多人带到同一个房间，就是会议。

root: 源自拉丁语 conferentia（con 一起 + ferre 携带），本义是聚到一起，后指大型会议与私下协商。

sensesIntro.en: From people carried into one hall, to a few people talking behind a door, and finally to the meeting itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被带进同一大厅的人群，到关起门交谈的少数人，最后到会议本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many chairs, one long table, and everyone facing the same subject.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多椅子、一张长桌，所有人都朝向同一个主题。

branches.en: The large meeting is the public and formal side of the word.
branches.cn: 大型会议是这个词公开而正式的一面。

branches.en: The private talk is the same idea behind a closed door.
branches.cn: 私下商谈是同一个意思关起门来的样子。

branches.en: Both sizes of meeting exist to move a subject forward.
branches.cn: 两种规模的会议都为了推动一个议题。

branches.en: A conference is measured by what people carry home from it.
branches.cn: 衡量一场会议，看人们从中带走了什么。

branches.en: A short conference can settle what a long debate cannot.
branches.cn: 一场短商谈有时能解决长辩论解决不了的事。

intro.en: Conference is Latin com-, together, plus ferre, to carry, with the noun ending -ence.
intro.cn: conference 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、ferre（携带）与名词词尾 -ence 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin carry base fer- also appears in transfer and refer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的携带词基 fer- 也出现在 transfer 与 refer 中。

items.example: She attends three conferences a year.
items.exampleCN: 她一年参加三场会议。
这场会议持续了两天。
评审团今晚将进行商议。

items.example: The conferment of the medal was brief.
items.exampleCN: 奖章的授予过程很短。

items.example: The conferral of rights took years.
items.exampleCN: 这些权利的授予花了好几年。

items.meaning: holding meetings by phone or video
items.example: The team uses video conferencing daily.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队每天使用视频会议。

items.meaning: a meeting held to answer journalists
items.example: The coach called a press conference.
items.exampleCN: 教练召开了一场记者招待会。

items.meaning: to carry across to another place
items.example: Please transfer the call to my office.
items.exampleCN: 请把电话转接到我的办公室。

definition_en: to admit that you have done something wrong
core_image: 一个人低着头，把藏在心里很久的事说出来
scene: 审讯室里，他终于承认自己拿了那笔钱。He finally confessed that he had taken the money.
sceneCN: 这里 confess 指「承认」（第 1 个义项：说出自己做过的错事）；句意是他终于承认自己拿了那笔钱。

senses.title: Admit a personal fault
senses.definition: to admit to other people that you did something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 向别人承认自己做了错事
senses.example: She confessed that she had lost the key.
senses.exampleCN: 她承认自己把钥匙弄丢了。
senses.why: A fault kept inside grows, and saying it out loud lets it shrink.
senses.whyCN: 藏着的过错会变大，说出口反而让它缩小。

senses.title: Admit a crime to police
senses.definition: to tell the police or a court that you committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 向警方或法庭说明自己犯了罪
senses.example: The man confessed to the robbery.
senses.exampleCN: 那名男子供认了抢劫行为。
senses.why: The law needs a clear statement before a case can be closed.
senses.whyCN: 案件要了结，法律需要一份清楚的陈述。

senses.title: Tell one's sins in church
senses.definition: to tell a priest about your sins and ask for forgiveness
senses.definitionCN: 向神父说出自己的罪并请求宽恕
senses.example: He went to church to confess his sins.
senses.exampleCN: 他去教堂忏悔自己的罪。
senses.why: The oldest sense is religious: a burden is handed over to a higher power.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义与宗教有关：把重担交给更高的力量。

intro.en: Confess comes from Latin confiteri, to admit fully, built from com-, completely, and fateri, to acknowledge.
intro.cn: confess 来自拉丁语 confiteri，意为彻底承认，由 com-（完全）与 fateri（承认）构成。

items.en: Fateri meant to admit or declare something openly.
items.cn: fateri 意为公开承认或声明某事。

items.en: Confiteri strengthened the act into a full and open admission.
items.cn: confiteri 把这一行为加强为彻底而公开的承认。

items.en: Old French confesser used the word mainly for religious confession.
items.cn: 古法语 confesser 主要把这个词用于宗教告解。

items.en: English confess first meant to declare one's sins to a priest.
items.cn: 英语 confess 最初指向神父告明自己的罪。

items.en: It now also covers admitting a fault or a crime in everyday life.
items.cn: 如今它也覆盖日常生活中承认错误或罪行。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that share the ending of confess, and the meaning group names other ways of admitting something.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 confess 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他表示承认的说法。

entries.definition: to state a belief or feeling openly
to make someone unable to think clearly
to face a problem or person directly
to agree that something is true
to accept that a fact is real
to make something hidden known

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a secret held too long, then move to a police room and to a quiet church.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从藏得太久的秘密开始，再走到警局房间与安静的教堂。

normal.en: Con- is fully and fess- is admit, so to confess is to admit fully.
normal.cn: con- 是完全，fess- 是承认，所以 confess 就是彻底承认。

normal.en: A confession is a door that only opens from the inside.
normal.cn: 坦白是一扇只能从里面打开的门。

normal.en: Confess and confession share the same body, one is the act and one is the words.
normal.cn: confess 与 confession 同根，一个是动作，一个是说出口的话。

normal.en: In church, confession is spoken in a whisper; in court, in a clear voice.
normal.cn: 在教堂里，忏悔是低声说的；在法庭上，供认是清楚说的。

normal.en: The moment you confess, the secret stops being heavy.
normal.cn: 你说出真相的那一刻，秘密就不再沉重。

abstract.en: Picture a hand opening a clenched fist.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手慢慢松开紧握的拳头。

abstract.en: Picture a small dark room with one narrow window.
abstract.cn: 想象一间只有一扇窄窗的小黑屋。

abstract.en: Picture a stone lifted off a covered well.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头从井口上被搬开。

examples.en: He confessed that he had broken the window.
examples.cn: 他承认自己打破了窗户。

examples.en: She refused to confess to a crime she did not commit.
examples.cn: 她拒绝供认自己没有犯过的罪。

examples.en: The old man went to confess before the holiday.
examples.cn: 节日前那位老人去做了忏悔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 confess 记成 con（完全）加 fess（说）：把藏在心里的事完全说出来，就是承认与忏悔。

root: 源自拉丁语 confiteri（com 完全 + fateri 承认），本义是完全承认，后引申为坦白、供认与宗教忏悔。

sensesIntro.en: From a personal fault spoken aloud, to a crime admitted to police, and finally to sins told in church.
sensesIntro.cn: 从说出口的个人过失，到向警方供认的罪行，最后到在教堂告明的罪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that has held a secret for years finally opens.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只握了许多年秘密的手终于松开。

branches.en: Everyday confession is about a small fault and a relieved mind.
branches.cn: 日常的承认关乎一个小过失与一颗放松下来的心。

branches.en: Legal confession turns private knowledge into public record.
branches.cn: 法律上的供认把私下的知情变成公开记录。

branches.en: Religious confession hands the weight to a higher power.
branches.cn: 宗教忏悔把重担交给更高的力量。

branches.en: Both ask for forgiveness, one from a person and one from heaven.
branches.cn: 两者都请求宽恕，一个向人，一个向上天。

branches.en: A court confession is only the everyday act with the law listening.
branches.cn: 法庭上的供认，不过是日常承认多了法律在听。

intro.en: Confess is built on Latin com-, fully, plus fateri, to admit.
intro.cn: confess 由拉丁语 com-（完全）与 fateri（承认）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin admit base fess- also appears in profession and profess.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的承认词基 fess- 也出现在 profession 与 profess 中。

items.exampleCN: 我必须承认我忘了。
他只被抓到时才承认。
她把整件事都承认了。

items.example: He sat confessing to the officer.
items.exampleCN: 他坐着向警官坦白。
这份供词写了三页。
神父不带评判地听着。

items.example: The letter had a confessional tone.
items.exampleCN: 这封信带着忏悔的语气。

items.example: They profess great interest in the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他们声称对这个计划很有兴趣。

definition_en: a feeling of trust in yourself or in another person
core_image: 演讲者走上台时背挺得笔直，步子稳稳的
scene: 排练多次之后，她走上台时一点也不慌。Practice gave her the confidence to speak in public.
sceneCN: 这里 confidence 指「自信」（第 1 个义项：对自己能力的信任）；句意是练习给了她当众讲话的自信。

senses.title: Trust in yourself
senses.definition: a calm belief that you can do something well
senses.definitionCN: 平静地相信自己能把事情做好
senses.example: She answered every question with confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她信心十足地回答了每个问题。
senses.why: Repeated practice turns a shaky hope into steady certainty.
senses.whyCN: 反复练习把摇晃的希望变成稳定的确信。

senses.title: Trust in another person
senses.definition: a feeling that someone or something can be relied on
senses.definitionCN: 觉得某人或某物可以依靠的感觉
senses.example: I have great confidence in your judgement.
senses.exampleCN: 我非常信任你的判断。
senses.why: Trust is a bet placed on someone else's steadiness.
senses.whyCN: 信任是把赌注押在别人的稳当上。

senses.title: A secret shared privately
senses.definition: a secret told to someone with a promise of silence
senses.definitionCN: 在对方承诺保密的情况下说出的秘密
senses.example: They exchanged confidences late at night.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在深夜交换了彼此的秘密。
senses.why: To trust someone with a secret is to lend them part of yourself.
senses.whyCN: 把秘密托付给人，就是把一部分自己借给了对方。

intro.en: Confidence comes from Latin confidentia, a trusting, from confidere, to trust completely.
intro.cn: confidence 来自拉丁语 confidentia，意为信赖，源自 confidere（完全信任）。

items.en: Fidere meant to trust or have faith in someone.
items.cn: fidere 意为信任或对某人抱有信心。

items.en: Confidere added com- to make the trust complete.
items.cn: confidere 加上 com-，表示彻底地信任。

items.en: French confidence named a firm hope or assurance.
items.cn: 法语 confidence 指坚定的希望或把握。

items.en: English confidence first meant reliance on another person.
items.cn: 英语 confidence 最初指对他人的依靠。

items.en: It now also means belief in oneself and a secret told in trust.
items.cn: 如今它也指对自己的信心，以及在信任中吐露的秘密。
